name: Pocket Letter Chords
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Hold the first chord letter and press the second within 80 ms to insert the saved text.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Pocket Letter Chords is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for keeping it in your editor.
